messages.subject: Global Energy & Resources Executive | ESG, Government Relations & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear AP GlobalEnergy Team,

Your international energy and resources recruitment coverage is highly relevant to my leadership background. I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with responsibility across government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am pursuing Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership mandates where energy and resources growth depends on credible institutional engagement, regulatory discipline and responsible development. Saudi Arabia and the UAE are priority markets, and I am internationally mobile.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
